Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the gathered data, stating that Raymond Cannon died in 1951 when the sources shown by WebSurfer indicated June 7, 1977. This misattribution led to the incorrect conclusion that Why Leave Home? had the director who died first. In reality, James Kirkwood Sr. (1963) died before Raymond Cannon (1977), so A Dream Or Two Ago should have been the correct answer.
